answer: Trace funding lineage. When a new agent's first coins or gas arrive, the ledger records which wallet paid, like strata in shale. Accounts whose funding traces back to one common source within a few hops are grouped into a cluster, and each cluster shares a single reward cap per epoch. A farm of a thousand keys seeded from one pearl of capital earns like one agent, so spinning up fakes is as barren as tundra, while independent agents keep full rewards.
